name: @ahpd/agent-cofold
description: An AHP backend over the cofold agent runtime: every model it can reach is a model inside one provider
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Agent Cofold
ahpd.description: Runs the Cofold agent runtime, providing access to OpenAI-compat api endpoints.

model.description: The model id a record that names none runs on.

baseUrl.description: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint a record that names none uses.

instructions.description: The system prompt a record that names none is created with.

computerConfigDir.description: The configuration directory the harness reads inside a machine. /ahpd/cofold by default; false leaves the image's own.

store.description: The folder each record's cofold file store lives under, one folder per record. The tool's own data directory by default.

memory.description: true to hold each record's store in memory, for a test.

tools.description: Which capabilities a session runs, where web_search gets its providers, and whether a write needs the file read first.

strictTools.description: false holds the tools option to the loose check, so a key the harness does not know is dropped rather than refused.

apiKey.description: The daemon's own key, for a record that names none.

resource.description: The protected resource a client authenticates against.

autoCompactTokens.description: The estimated history size at which a session compacts, never above 80% of the model's listed context, or of 32000. That 80% by default.
